description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.skins object, which manages loading and registration of skins for the CKEditor rich text editor. It includes functions for adding skins, loading skin parts, and handling skin-related resources such as CSS and JavaScript files.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new skin definition with a specified name and definition object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific part of a skin (e.g., 'editor' or 'dialog') for a given editor instance, handling CSS and JS dependencies.
